Title: Azure Site Recovery supports Gen 2 VM protection in West US, North Europe, and Japan West

Body.Content: We’re extremely pleased to announce that Azure Site Recovery now supports the ability to protect and recover Generation 2 virtual machines to Azure. This feature is currently available in the West US, North Europe, and Japan West regions. We’ll send announcements as this feature becomes available in other regions. For more details, check out Disaster Recovery to Azure enhanced, and we’re listening!
Body.Markdown:
We’re extremely pleased to announce that Azure Site Recovery now supports the ability to protect and recover Generation 2 virtual machines to Azure. This feature is currently available in the West US, North Europe, and Japan West regions. We’ll send announcements as this feature becomes available in other regions.

For more details, check out Disaster Recovery to Azure enhanced, and we’re listening!
